description: This file defines the TitleEditor activity for an Android notepad application. It provides UI for editing a note's title, retrieves the current title from the content provider, and saves changes back to the provider. It manages lifecycle events to ensure the title is saved appropriately.

classes.name: TitleEditor
classes.description: An Activity that allows users to edit the title of a note within the notepad application. It loads the current note title on creation and saves changes when the activity stops or the user confirms.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves the note based on URI, and displays the current title.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles resumption of the activity; currently just calls super.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Handles activity pause; currently just calls super.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Called when activity is stopping; saves the current title into the database.

methods.name: onClickOk
methods.description: Handles the OK button click, saves the title, and finishes the activity.

methods.name: saveTitle
methods.description: Saves the current title text to the content provider if changed, or shows a toast if the title is blank.
